product: Configure materialization TTLs for individual OpenSharing recipients
tagline: You can now set the materialization time to live (TTL) for each open sharing recipient, overriding the metastore default.
what_it_does: You can now set the materialization time to live (TTL) for each open sharing recipient, overriding the metastore default. As a data provider, manage OpenSharing recipients in Databricks to grant share access, update properties, and control materialization caching. A recipient is the named object that represents the identity of a user or group with whom you share data.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: You can now set the materialization time to live (TTL) for each open sharing recipient, overriding the metastore default.
